assessments.finding_note: “吕布和李儒看出疑点”略有时序模糊：吕布先提出怀疑，李儒随后才到并分析。
assessments.reason: The summary preserves both characters’ suspicion and the subsequent decision to pursue Cao Cao; only their exact sequence is slightly blurred.
